items.root_cause: a text sweep over production scripts has no way to tell a frozen fixture from a live pin: it discriminates by file name and by a leading '#', and a fixture that must carry the retired literal to prove the refusal has to sit on a non-comment line of a production file. Any of the 5 such sweeps fires the moment any of the 91 -SelfTest blocks freezes the shape it hunts. A comment marker cannot fix the class because a marker can be copied onto a live line (triage-plans/README.md: the fixture marker scoped away from -SelfTest blocks on 2026-09-09 met its next fixture within the hour); a `$SelfTest` branch is dead in production by construction and cannot be

root_fix.what: one shared production-text reader, adopted by all 5 grocery text sweeps, so no -SelfTest fixture can page a sweep and no marker exists to copy
root_fix.exact_change: test-guards.ps1:559-563 (Test-HasThrowingIdiom's input), test-auditors.ps1:569-575 (u009 array-wrap scan) and :3967-3977 (the search-term [string] cast scan), audit-store-registry.ps1:506-509 (Get-StoreListDrift's input) read lines through Get-TcProductionLines; each keeps its existing skip list for files that quote the pattern as prose or as detector text. lib/production-text.ps1 -SelfTest (discovered by ops/run-gates.ps1): MUST FIRE a needle on a top-level line is returned; MUST NOT FIRE the byte-identical line inside `if ($SelfTest) { }` is not returned, nor one inside a function defined inside that block; CLEAN TWIN a needle inside `if ($selftest -and $x)` (not the bare condition) IS still returned, so the scope stays narrow

items.root_cause: a raw-protein commodity's rule is a bare include with type-word excludes, and category-excludes.json's ^Meat block has no class for a prepared dish that carries its protein's name (soups, chowders, bisques, sushi), so every such product is eligible at every one of the 47 Meat commodities and only the sanity outlier arm sees the cheap ones; the raw/cooked form the label promises is expressed nowhere in the schema. Ten prior closes of this type were ten different mechanisms (pack arithmetic, two-size lines, a unit-price attribute, a fuel-saver clause, donut holes, a snack bar); none could have stopped this one because the missing thing was a CLASS, not a token

root_fix.what: two new classes in the category-exclude library, baked into every ^Meat and every Fruit/Vegetables commodity by the sanctioned tool, and hard-failed by audit-food-category
root_fix.exact_change: category-excludes.json classes += soup_carrier ['\bchowder\b', '\bsoup\b', '\bbisque\b', '\bgumbo\b'] and sushi_carrier ['\bsushi\b']; apply blocks ^Meat and ^(Fruit|Vegetables)$ += both classes; exempt soup_carrier '' and sushi_carrier '' (measured: no commodity in either block is a soup or a sushi; canned-chili, clam-chowder and tomato-soup sit in other blocks). Run apply-category-excludes.ps1 (it writes ASCII-pinned, no BOM); wire both classes into audit-food-category.ps1 the way sausage_carrier was on 2026-09-02 so the class hard-fails estate-wide; test-auditors gains the case

items.leaves_open: prepared-seafood shapes no class token names: 'Fremont Fish Market Salted Butter Shrimp Skewer 8 OZ' (Aldi $6.79 / 8 oz = $13.58/lb) and the fresh 'Member's Mark Jumbo Gulf Shrimp, Service Counter' ($10.47/lb, not frozen) stay on shrimp; neither prices a cell (Aldi cell 8.245 on the Value Pack, Sam's 5.82). The schema still carries no raw/cooked form attribute, so 'cooked' is a shrimp-only exclude: a cooked product at another Meat commodity is still decided token by token

prevention.what: the class library is the schema that makes a commodity born with its fences and audit-food-category is the check that hard-fails the class on every board; a prepared dish named for its protein is refused at every Meat and produce commodity, not at shrimp alone. items.root_cause: both Freshop callers plan their pages from their own limit and page= and accept a 200 with a correct total as a complete read. Freshop silently clamps limit to 100 on /products and ignores page= and offset= on both endpoints (skip= is the pager), so a loop that never checks unique ids against total reads page 1 forever and reports 11 x 100 duplicates as 1,100 deals. The shape sits in two files because there is no shared Freshop pager, and nothing downstream compares rows delivered against total

root_fix.what: one Freshop pager, used by both callers, that cannot report a duplicate page as progress; the offers loop removed unless a one-time measurement finds a reason to keep it
